Is There Any Information For The Parent Of A Student?
CFD campus welcomes parents at the campus on any day for student's academic information
or record discussion. It is suggested that parents must visit the student's profile on LMS.
Do Employers Recruit Students On Campus?
The career services Office regularly shares available employment opportunities offered by

How Do I Contact CFD Campus Alumni?

several societies, covering a wide variety of interests, are available for students to join or

Computing labs, engineering labs, common rooms, sports grounds, fitness center, medical

The emergency medical centre is located near the Boys Hostel on the campus. In case of serious

FAST-NUCES CFD Campus provides an in-house hostel facility for boys and girls. These facilities

ABOUT HOSTEL
FAST NUCES Chiniot Faisalabad is the first fully residential campus of FAST NUCES. It provides
secure & well-managed hostel facilities for both male and female students, accommodating
around 1000 residents. The campus offers separate & well-structured residential arrange-
ments for boys and girls to ensure a safe, comfortable, and disciplined living environment.
The boys' hostel consists of three buildings, including Iqbal Hall and Jinnah Hall, with a
total capacity of approximately 750 students, while the girls' hostel is a separate, dedicated,
and fully secure residential block with a capacity of around 250 students. Both hostels are
designed to facilitate students coming from different cities (other than district Faisalabad),
ensuring convenience and easy access to on-campus living while maintaining appropriate
segregation and security standards.
In both boys' and girls' hostels, furnished rooms are provided to meet the academic and
residential needs of students. Each room is equipped with essential furniture such as
beds, study tables, chairs, and cupboards, ensuring a comfortable and organized environment
that supports both study and rest.
Mess facilities are available in both boys' and girls' hostels, offering nutritious and hygienic
meals three times a day. The student mess hall is designed to efficiently accommodate
its respective hostel residents, ensuring a well-managed dining environment and promoting
healthy eating habits among students. Other than the hostel mess, the students may opt
to eat at the university cafeteria and dhaba.
A fully functional medical facility is available for both male and female students through
the medical center. This facility provides timely healthcare services, addressing routine
medical needs as well as emergencies, thereby ensuring the well-being and safety of all
hostel residents.
For physical fitness and well-being, a fully equipped gymnasium is provided within the
hostel. The gym contains modern exercise machines and fitness equipment that support
various forms of physical training, encouraging students to maintain an active and
healthy lifestyle.
Both male and female hostels include a separate prayer room. In addition, hostels have
well-maintained grounds and sports facilities after university hours. These facilities su pport a
wide range of outdoor games and physical activities, promoting teamwork, discipline,
and overall physical fitness among students while contributing to a balanced campus
life.
Overall, the hostel facilities at FAST NUCES Chiniot Faisalabad are purpose-built to provide
a secure, comfortable, and well-equipped residential environment for both male and
female students. These arrangements not only support academic success but also promote
health, discipline, and a balanced campus lifestyle,

text_overrides.23:
FAQs ABOUT HOSTELS
How Can I Reach The Hostel?
A pick-and-drop facility is available for hostel residents. Pickup and drop-off services are
provided according to the notified schedule.
What Is The Procedure For A Hostel Student If He/She Wants To Go For Shopping?
Twice a week, shuttle service will be provided for male students to go to Faisalabad for
shopping, and once a week for female students to go to Faisalabad for shopping. However,
the number of trips in a semester for each student is limited to 6. Moreover, transportation
shall be provided subject to the availability of a bus and driver.
If A Student Wants To Go Out From Campus, Then What's The Procedure?
The student shall apply for a gate pass. He/She will visit the relevant office, & the authorized
representative at the designated place shall verify it with his/her parent/guardian and
approve or reject the gate pass.
Are Outsiders Allowed To Stay At Hostel?
Outsiders are not allowed to stay or enter the hostel premises. However, parents or legal
guardians of the concerned student may visit the hostel during the designated visiting
hours. TO ensure the privacy & comfort of all residents, parents/guardians are not permitted to
enter or visit students' rooms.
What Kind Of Food Is Provided At Hostel Mess?
Optional food is provided three times a day for students who choose to avail the facility.
However, students can bring food from home in a storage box, which may be consumed
within two weeks. Each resident is allowed one food storage container with a maximum size
of approximately 6 in x 6 in x 6 in (Length x Width x Height)
What Is The Security Fee For New Students?
For new students, a one-time security fee of Rs. 22,000/- is applicable.
What Does The Hostel Fee Include?
The hostel fee does not include mess expenses. Facilities such as shuttle service & electricity
are included. However, students opting for air-conditioners will be charged separately based
on electricity consumption.
Who Is Responsible For The Installation And Electricity Charges Of An Air-
Conditioner?
The installation of the air-conditioner in the room &the division/ payment of the electricity
bill shall be the sole responsibility of the students.
What Are The Charges For An Air Cooler?
Air cooler charges are fixed at Rs. 3,000/— per month.
text_overrides.24:
FAQs ABOUT HOSTELS
Are Single- And Double-Occupancy Rooms Available For All Students?
As per policy, single- and double-occupancy rooms are reserved exclusively for graduating
batches with top CGPAs or for students with valid medical reasons. This medical reason shall
be valid after the endorsement of the Medical Officer, the Hall Management Committee, & approval
from the competent authority. The new batch will be accommodated in shared rooms.
How Can I Join The Gym Facility At Hostels?
Students may avail the hostel gym facility by paying a maintenance fee of Rs. 5,000 per
semester or Rs. 2,000 per month, along with a one-time registration fee of Rs. 1,000.

text_overrides.1:
FAST-NUCES
 Financial Assistance / Scholarships
Webpage snapshot | Collected 8 October 2026 Source: https://www.nu.edu.pk/Admissions/Scholarship
Reformatted copy of the scholarship content for the student-helpdesk knowledge base. This is not an official
university-issued PDF. Collection date is not a policy effective date. Website navigation and footer are omitted;
scholarship content is retained.
A. Internal Sponsorships
1. Merit Scholarships for Bachelor Students
Merit scholarship is awarded to the Top Three position holders of each Examination Board in the year of
admission. Merit Scholarship is also offered to Top Three position holders in the merit list of NU admission merit
list of each campuses. The University awards certificates and cash prizes to those undergraduate students, who
are the Top Three in their department. Students are selected from each of the four years of every degree
program. This scholarship is for four years of un-interrupted studies with standard courses (core and elective),
labs and final year projects of the degree offered by the department in a semester to a batch with a specified
number of total credit hours and is equal to the full tuition fee. A student registering for less or more credit hours
than the total specified number of credit hours shall not be eligible for Merit Scholarship. Student must not have
failed, repeated or withdrawn from a course in that semester. If there are more than one student in the same
position, the next position will automatically be vanished or moved down depending on the number of students in
one position. Continuation of merit scholarship is subject to maintaining semester GPA of 3.0 or higher.
2. Study Loan
Realizing that fees may not be affordable for some of the students, FAST-NU arranges financial assistance in the
form of interest-free study loans for bright indigent students.
Download loan application form: https://nu.edu.pk/public/downloads/fa-form/fa-form-2026.pdf
3. Rules for Internal Sponsorships:
1. Internal sponsorships are available for studying in regular semesters (spring and Fall). Following is the
maximum number of semesters for which it can be availed. Bachelors: 8 semesters. 2. It shall not be available for repeat or withdrawn courses. This implies that it is available for
studying a course only once. 3. It is suspended if the student’s CGPA falls below the minimum specified to avoid
warning and shall be restored upon getting out of warning by improvement in CGPA. 4. It shall be limited to tuition
fee only.
B. External Sponsorships
1. Sindh Government Endowment Board Scholarships
This is offered on need-cum-merit to rural and urban students in both Undergraduate and Graduate level for all
disciplines. Scholarship covers full tuition fee for the entire duration of the program, renewable every year. The
scholarship quota for rural sector is 60% and for Urban is 40%.
2. ICT Scholarships and Balochistan Endowment Scholarships
ICT Scholarships refer to the Prime Minister's National ICT Scholarship Program, a program by Ignite (formerly
National ICT R&D Fund) that provides financial assistance to students pursuing ICT degrees. Balochistan
Endowment Scholarships, specifically the Balochistan Education Endowment Fund (BEEF), aims to support the
education of talented students from Balochistan, including those from less privileged backgrounds.

text_overrides.2:
3. Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF) Scholarships
The PEEF provides financial assistance to talented and needy students in Punjab and other provinces of
Pakistan, including Azad Jammu & Kashmir, FATA, Gilgit Baltistan, and Islamabad Capital Territory. It aims to
support students pursuing Intermediate, Graduation, and Master's level degrees. PEEF was established to
address the gap in educational opportunities for deserving students by providing scholarships and other financial
assistance.
4. Punjab Honhaar Scholarship Program
The Honhaar Scholarship Program, an initiative of the Punjab Higher Education Commission, aims to provide
financial assistance to deserving and meritorious students pursuing higher education at universities and colleges
in Punjab, Pakistan. The program seeks to ensure equal access to quality education, particularly for those with
limited financial resources.
6. OSAF Scholarships
OSAF (Old Students Association of FAST) arranges financial assistance for those students who cannot afford to
pay their full fee.
7. FANA Scholarship
FAST Alumni of North America provide funds for financial assistance for students who cannot afford to pay their
full fee.
8. Ihsan Trust Financial Assistance
Ihsan Trust financial assistance for students who cannot afford to pay their full fee.
9. Other Scholarships
In addition to the above scholarships there are various community-based scholarships offered by various
committees and foundations such as, Memon Community Scholarships, Bohra Community Scholarships, Agha
Khan Foundation Scholarships, etc.
10. Repayment of Study Loan
The repayment of loan starts three months after graduation or soon after getting employment, whichever is
earlier. The total amount has to be repaid within a period of four years after graduation. Students are required to
sign a contract allowing future employers to deduct loan repayments at source and remit it to the University.
